title: common/pkg/hooks: support Go 1.27 unmarshal error format in tests
body:
In Go 1.27, `encoding/json.UnmarshalTypeError` no longer includes the enclosing struct name prefix in this context, outputting `.hook` instead of `Hook.hook`.

Update the regex assertions in `TestBadFile` and `TestInvalidCurrentJSON` to match `(Hook)?\.hook` so that the tests pass on both Go ≤ 1.26 and Go ≥ 1.27.

Fixes #1174
